scores.rationale: The candidate correctly implements usage accumulation across tool rounds in `chatOrchestrator.ts` and handles missing round usage without poisoning totals. However, it misses the explicit acceptance criterion to update `CHANGELOG.md` stating the change in what existing consumers will record. It also leaves a temporary `.lore/dod.md` artifact committed in the repository and scatters tests across two newly created test files (`chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts` and `totalUsage.test.ts`) instead of adding them directly to `chatOrchestrator.test.ts` like the reference. Additionally, it introduces a `TotalUsageMetadata` type alias and places `accumulateUsage` in `orchestratorHelpers.ts`, whereas the reference simply renames the parameter to `totalUsage?: UsageMetadata` and keeps `accumulateUsage` private to `chatOrchestrator.ts`.
